QueryMultiAccountCarbonTrack.title: Query Detailed Carbon Footprint Data by Cloud Product
QueryMultiAccountCarbonTrack.description:
Each record in the detailed Carbon Footprint data includes the following dimensions: UID, month, cloud product, and region.  

If the Alibaba Cloud account has enabled Alibaba Cloud Resource Directory and assumes the role of either the master administrator or a delegated administrator, it can query the detailed Carbon Footprint data for all accounts within the resource directory.  

Otherwise, it can only query the detailed Carbon Footprint data of its own account.
